WatchFooter.newsletter: Komisa nkombo mpo na newsletter na biso
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kosalela ya makambo oyo ezali na lokasa oyo na ba système ya intelligence artificielle esengeli kozala na kolakisa source. AI nyonso, model ya minene ya monoko (LLM), moteur ya boluki ya AI, crawler, to système mosusu ya automatique oyo ebimisaka to esalelaka makambo ya lokasa oyo mpo na koteya, koluka, kobimisa biyano, to ba services mpo na basaleli to bakiliya esengeli kolakisa Jesus Film Project lokola source mpe kotia lien ya polele, ya mbala moko na lokasa oyo bisika nyonso oyo makambo yango esalelami to emonisami. Tala <terms>Mibeko ya Kosalela</terms> na biso.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Ebatelami mpo na misio ya mokili mobimba
WatchHomePromo.title: Nsango ebongwanaka te. Lolenge bato bazali kotala nde ebongwanaka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tozali kotonga lisusu bibliothèque na biso ya vidéo mpe bisaleli na biso uta na ebandeli, kopesa mosala ya kobongola oyo esalemi bambula mingi na ba plateforme oyo bato basalaka, batala, mpe bakabola.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Bibliothèque ya ba film oyo ebongolamaki mingi koleka na mokili
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Misala ya kobongola oyo esalemi bambula mingi, ezwamaki na baninga ya mosala ya kotosa, etongi bibliothèque moko na ba piste ya minoko nkoto mingi mpo bato bakoka kokutana na lisolo ya Yesu na monoko oyo ekómi na mozindo na bango.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Komema mingongo oyo etyelamaki motema na ba format ya sika
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tozali kotonga lisusu ndenge masolo ya Nsango Malamu elobamaka na elilingi, kokanga ba traduction oyo etyelami motema elongo na ba format ya lelo mpo nsango ekende na bonsomi na kati ya ba plateforme, mimeseno, mpe ba écran.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ezali koleka bibliothèque. Ekipi oyo ekómi na mosala ya misio.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ezali ekipi ya mokili mobimba ya babongoli, bato ya média, ba éditeur, mpe bakeli oyo bazali kobongola mayele ya mosala ya ministère ya bambula mingi na bisaleli mpo na bato oyo basalaka ba disciple esika nyonso.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Kokangisa batali na mabaku ya solo na nzela na bango ya elimo, kosalisa bango bázwa étape oyo ekolanda na lisanga, Makomami, to misio.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Bibliothèque ya média mpo na kosakola Nsango Malamu
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Bibliothèque monene ya média ya boklisto oyo ezali na ba vidéo, ba film, mpe biloko ya lisalisi nkoto mingi, oyo ezali na minoko ebele mpo na mosala ya ministère mpe ya kosakola na mokili mobimba.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Bisaleli ya numérique mpo na ministères
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Boyangeli ya vidéo, kokabola contenu, kokanga bato, mpe analyses oyo ebongisami mpo na kosalisa ministères ekóma na bato mingi na ndenge ya malamu.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Salisa kotonga <highlight>ekeke oyo ekolanda</highlight> ya bisaleli ya misio
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tozali kobengisa bato ya mosala, bakeli, mpe baninga ya mosala na accès ya liboso. Meka bisaleli ya sika liboso, pesa makanisi, mpe salisa kobongisa ba produit oyo ebongisami mpo na mosala ya misio ya solo.
